root_cause.text: The dev3_register_work delayed work item is not properly canceled before freeing the alps_data structure, allowing a race where the work can be scheduled after flush_workqueue() and then execute on freed memory.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message detail the race: CPU 0 (cleanup path) calls flush_workqueue() then kfree(priv), while CPU 1 (delayed work) schedules dev3_register_work via psmouse_queue_work() after flush, leading to use-after-free when the work accesses priv->dev3. The patch adds `disable_delayed_work_sync(&priv->dev3_register_work)` in `alps_disconnect()` to ensure cancellation before deallocation.
